T0559.title: Fake Transaction
T0559.definition: A fabricated or collusive transaction used to inflate activity, move funds, earn rewards, or bypass controls.
T0559.description: Fake transactions create fabricated or collusive orders, payments, reviews, or fulfillment records. They can support brushing, subsidy abuse, cash-out, fake volume, ranking manipulation, or campaign-threshold bypass. Controls require linked analysis across accounts, devices, funds, logistics, merchants, and review behavior.
T0559.usageExample: Assess Fake Transaction related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
